# frontmatter-editing

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-001 — A click on a field in edit mode opens its editor in place](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-001.md) — When a writer clicks, or presses Enter or Space on, a name or value cell of the properties table in edit mode, the extension SHALL open a field editor inside that cell.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-002 — A field editor does not open while another editor is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-002.md) — When a field editor or a block editor is open, the extension SHALL NOT open another field editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-003 — Enum, number, date, boolean and nullable fields use fitting controls](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-003.md) — When a writer opens the editor of a schema enum, number, date, time, boolean or nullable field, the extension SHALL show the control that fits the type: a select offering the schema values for an enum, a native number, date or time input, a one-click toggle for a boolean and a Set to null button for a nullable field.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-004 — Text values are edited as one or several lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-004.md) — When a writer edits the value of a text field, the extension SHALL show a text box in which Enter saves a one-line value, Enter adds a line in a multi-line value, Cmd or Ctrl+Enter saves, and the saved value keeps no trailing line break unless the original had one and is written as a YAML literal block when it holds line breaks.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-005 — Trailing line breaks of a text value are dropped](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-005.md) — When a writer saves a text field, the extension SHALL remove the trailing line breaks of the typed value unless the original value ended with a line break.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-006 — A multi-line text value is written as a literal block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-006.md) — When a writer saves a text field with a value that holds line breaks, the extension SHALL write it into the frontmatter as a YAML literal block.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-007 — Number, date and time fields use native inputs](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-007.md) — When a writer opens the editor of a number, date or time field, the extension SHALL show a native number input with any step, a date input or a time input.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-008 — An invalid number is refused in the editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-008.md) — When a writer saves a number field whose input is empty or not a finite number, the extension SHALL show "Enter a valid number." in the editor and post nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-009 — A boolean field toggles with one click](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-009.md) — When a writer clicks the value cell of a schema boolean field in edit mode, the extension SHALL toggle the value and post the save at once.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-010 — List fields and link lists are edited item by item](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-010.md) — When a writer opens the editor of a list field, the extension SHALL show one text input per item, each with a drag handle and a remove button, an Add item button and no Save or Cancel button, and let the writer add, remove, reorder and save the items from the keyboard or by drag, with the known Markdown file stems offered on a list of filename-stem links.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-011 — Enter in a list item inserts an empty item after it](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-011.md) — When a writer presses Enter in a list item input, the extension SHALL insert an empty item after it and focus it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-012 — List items reorder by keyboard and drag](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-012.md) — When a writer presses ArrowUp or ArrowDown on the handle of a list item, or drags the handle over another item, the extension SHALL move the item and show the insertion position.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-013 — A plain click on a link value edits the field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-013.md) — When a writer plain-clicks a link inside a field value in edit mode, the extension SHALL open the field editor instead of following the link.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-014 — Link lists suggest the known Markdown file stems](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-014.md) — When a writer edits a list of filename-stem links, the extension SHALL offer the known Markdown file stems as suggestions on every item input, new items included.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-015 — Fields without a schema type are edited as YAML text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-015.md) — When a writer opens the editor of a field without a schema, of unknown type, list-typed with a non-list value or holding an object, the extension SHALL show a YAML text box of 1 to 20 rows holding the value as YAML.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-016 — The host refuses a value that breaks YAML, the field type or the schema](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-016.md) — When the host receives a frontmatter save whose YAML value does not parse or is empty, or whose value does not fit the field type or the schema, the extension SHALL refuse it with "Invalid YAML value: {parser message}" for a YAML value and with the matching message otherwise, and change nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-017 — Nullable fields offer Set to null](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-017.md) — When a writer edits a field whose schema allows null, the extension SHALL offer a Set to null button that saves the value null.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-018 — A null value is refused for a field that is not nullable](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-018.md) — When the host receives a null value for a schema field that does not allow null, the extension SHALL refuse the save with the stale-field message.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-019 — A field editor saves a changed value and Escape cancels it](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-019.md) — When a writer commits a field editor with Enter, with a checkbox change or by moving focus out of it, the extension SHALL post a save only when the value differs from the original, close the editor without a post on Escape, and show the progress and the outcome of the save in the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-020 — Escape cancels a field editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-020.md) — When a writer presses Escape in a field editor control or anywhere in the properties section, the extension SHALL close the editor without saving, unless a save is in flight.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-021 — Turning edit mode off closes a field editor without saving](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-021.md) — When a writer turns edit mode off while a field editor is open, the extension SHALL close the editor without posting its value.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-022 — A save in flight disables the editor and shows Saving](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-022.md) — While a field save is in flight, the extension SHALL disable the editor controls and show "Saving frontmatter…" in the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-023 — A refused field save stays visible in the editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-023.md) — When the host refuses a field save, the extension SHALL show the host message in the error state in the editor, enable the controls again and keep the editor open.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-024 — A click on a field name renames the key](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-024.md) — When a writer clicks a field name in edit mode, the extension SHALL open a key editor in the name cell whose suggestion list offers the schema keys not yet used, and rename the key from it on Enter or on leaving with a changed name, changing only the key text and keeping the comments.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-025 — Enter or leaving the key editor renames the key](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-025.md) — When a writer presses Enter in the key editor or leaves it with a changed name, the extension SHALL post a rename that changes only the key text and keeps the comments.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-026 — An empty or padded key name is refused in the key editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-026.md) — When a writer commits a key name that is empty or has leading or trailing spaces, the extension SHALL show "Enter a non-empty key without leading or trailing spaces." in the editor and post nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-027 — The host refuses a rename to a name already used](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-027.md) — When the host receives a rename to a name that another field already has, the extension SHALL refuse it with 'A frontmatter field named "{name}" already exists.'
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-028 — The field action menu offers the missing schema fields or a custom key](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-028.md) — When a field editor is open, the extension SHALL show inside the edited row, after the control, a field action menu labelled "Frontmatter field actions" with an "Add field" button that adds a field chosen among the schema fields still missing or typed as a custom key.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-029 — Remove field deletes exactly the lines of a non-required field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-029.md) — When a field editor is open, the extension SHALL show in its field action menu a "Remove field" button for the edited row, which deletes exactly the lines of that field and keeps the comment lines above it, and which is disabled and refused by the host for a field the schema requires.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-030 — Remove field deletes exactly the lines of the field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-030.md) — When a writer removes a field, the extension SHALL delete exactly the lines of that field and keep the comment lines above it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-031 — Remove field is disabled for a schema-required field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-031.md) — When the field editor of a schema-required field is open, the extension SHALL disable the Remove field button with the tooltip "Required by the schema; it cannot be removed".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-032 — The host refuses to remove a required field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-032.md) — When the host receives a remove that would leave a required field missing, the extension SHALL refuse it with 'Cannot remove required frontmatter field "{name}".'
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-033 — The Add field picker lists the schema fields still missing](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-033.md) — When a writer chooses Add field and the schema has fields not in the document, the extension SHALL show a select of those fields and add the chosen one at once with its default value.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-034 — Without schema fields to add, a typed field name is added](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-034.md) — When a writer chooses Add field and the schema has no field left to add, the extension SHALL show a text input "New field name" and an Add button that adds a key with an empty value.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-035 — The picker offers a Custom key when extra properties are allowed](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-035.md) — When the Add field picker lists schema fields and the schema allows additional properties, the extension SHALL add "Custom key…" to the select and show a "New field name" input that adds the typed key with an empty value on Enter.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-036 — An invalid custom key name is refused in the picker](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-036.md) — When a writer enters an empty, space-padded, multi-line or existing custom key name, the extension SHALL show the matching message in the editor and post nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-037 — An added field is one inserted line where its row shows, and its editor opens](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-037.md) — When a writer adds a field, the extension SHALL insert it as one line where its row shows and open the editor of the new field once: with a schema right after the present field that precedes it in schema order or right before the next one when it comes first, without a schema after the row whose menu was used, else at the end of the block.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-038 — Without a schema, an added field follows the row whose menu was used](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-038.md) — When a writer adds a field to a document without a schema, the extension SHALL insert it after the row whose menu was used, else at the end of the block.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-039 — An added field is a single inserted line in the file's line endings](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-039.md) — When a writer adds a field, the extension SHALL write it as one inserted line, a list in the compact sequence style, using the line endings of the file.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-040 — The editor of an added field opens by itself once](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-040.md) — When the table is re-rendered after an add, the extension SHALL open the editor of the new field once, also across the page reload that follows.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-041 — A pending new-field editor is dropped when it cannot be used](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-041.md) — When edit mode is off, the row of the new field is missing or the add failed, the extension SHALL drop the pending edit instead of opening an editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-042 — A new custom key is saved as a plain scalar when that is safe](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-042.md) — When a writer saves the text of a just-added custom key, the extension SHALL write it as a plain YAML scalar when it reads back as the same string, and quote it otherwise.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-043 — A frontmatter edit changes only the lines of its field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-043.md) — When a writer saves a value, the extension SHALL change only the lines of that field and keep comments, quoting style, spacing, fences, body and line endings byte-identical, and refuse an edit that would leave a block that does not parse or whose keys are not exactly the expected ones.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-044 — Anchored or aliased values fall back to a whole-block rewrite](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-044.md) — When the edited value carries a YAML anchor or alias, the extension SHALL fall back to rewriting the whole block while still writing the right data.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-045 — A frontmatter edit that loses or corrupts a key is refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-045.md) — When a frontmatter edit would leave a block that does not parse or whose keys are not exactly the expected ones, the extension SHALL refuse it with "The frontmatter YAML could not be updated."
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-046 — Values ending in three dots or dashes stay inside the block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-046.md) — When a field value ends in ... or ---, the extension SHALL keep it inside the frontmatter block when editing another field.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-047 — A value that does not fit the field type is refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-047.md) — When a schema is found and the saved value is not of the field's type or not one of its enum values, the extension SHALL refuse the save with "The frontmatter field is stale or its value does not match the schema."
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-048 — A schema error on the edited field refuses the save](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-048.md) — When the edited document has a schema error on the edited field, the extension SHALL refuse the save with "Schema validation failed: {message}".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-049 — Only errors of the edited field block a save](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-049.md) — When the edited field has no schema error other than a link problem, the extension SHALL accept the save even if other fields or links of the frontmatter are invalid.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-050 — Editor controls do not apply the schema hints](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-050.md) — When a writer edits a number or text field, the extension SHALL show the control without the schema minimum, maximum, length or pattern limits and leave out-of-range values to the check at save time.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-051 — A save in an untrusted workspace is refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-051.md) — When the preview is read-only because the workspace is untrusted or the file is outside the workspace, the extension SHALL refuse a frontmatter save with "Editing requires a trusted workspace."
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-052 — A save from an older render is refused with a reopen hint](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-052.md) — When a frontmatter save comes from an editor opened on an older render than the host holds, the extension SHALL answer "The preview changed while this field was being edited. Reopen the field."
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-053 — A save VS Code rejects is reported](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-053.md) — When VS Code rejects the workspace edit of a frontmatter save, the extension SHALL answer with "VS Code could not apply the frontmatter edit." or the error text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-054 — A frontmatter save message names its editor and field, or is ignored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-054.md) — When a previewFrontmatterSave message is malformed, because it does not name a non-empty editId and fieldName or carries a field outside its accepted shape, the extension SHALL ignore it without a reply.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-055 — Each frontmatter save is one document edit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-055.md) — When the host applies a frontmatter save, the extension SHALL apply it as one edit of the document so that one Undo reverts it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-056 — Undo and redo keys in a field editor act on the field text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-056.md) — When a writer presses the undo or redo keys in a field editor control, the extension SHALL leave them to the control and not pass them to the document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-057 — The properties section keeps its place across the save](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-057.md) — When a writer saves a field, the extension SHALL send the properties section's source line and viewport top with the save so that the section keeps its screen position after the re-render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-058 — Refresh is blocked while a field editor is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-058.md) — While a field editor is open, the extension SHALL disable the toolbar Refresh button and refuse a refresh with "Save or cancel this edit before refreshing." in the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-059 — A checkbox toggle is refused while a field editor is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-059.md) — While a field editor is open, the extension SHALL refuse a task-list checkbox click with "Save or cancel this edit before toggling a checkbox." in the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-060 — A properties update waits until the field editor closes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-060.md) — When the host sends an updated properties table while a field editor is open, the extension SHALL defer it and apply it when the editor closes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-061 — A content patch closes the field editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-061.md) — When a content patch of the page arrives while a field editor is open, the extension SHALL close the editor and drop the waiting properties update.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-062 — Boundary navigation does not step into the properties table](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-062.md) — When a writer presses ArrowUp at the start of the first body block editor, the extension SHALL NOT move the editor onto the properties table.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-063 — The properties table is never part of a block selection or move](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-063.md) — When a writer selects or moves blocks, the extension SHALL exclude the properties table from the selection and from the move.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-064 — The insert point after the table has no move buttons](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-064.md) — When the insert point after the properties table, or the Start writing point of a frontmatter-only document, is shown, the extension SHALL show no move buttons on it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-065 — A field editor opens and closes on Escape in a 460 px preview without page overflow](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-065.md) — When the preview is 460 px wide in edit mode, the extension SHALL open a field editor on click and close it on Escape without horizontal overflow of the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-066 — Field and key editors have no palette or slash menu](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-066.md) — When a writer types in a field or key editor, the extension SHALL NOT show the edition palette or the slash menu.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-067 — A navigation saves the open field editor as an unchecked flush](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-067.md) — When a navigation or a host flush request occurs while a field or key editor is open, the extension SHALL save the typed text as a flush before leaving, which the host writes as typed, skipping the type, YAML and schema checks.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-068 — A flush save is written without the type and schema check](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-068.md) — When the host receives a frontmatter save with the flush flag, the extension SHALL write the value as typed, skipping the type, YAML and schema checks.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-069 — A refused flush warns that the typed text was dropped](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-069.md) — When the host refuses a flush save, the extension SHALL show a warning that the typed text was not saved.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-070 — A normal frontmatter save carries no flush flag](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-070.md) — When a writer commits a field editor with Enter or by leaving it, the extension SHALL post the save without the flush flag.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-071 — A refused plain save is saved again as a flush before a navigation](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-071.md) — When a navigation waits for a plain save that the host refuses, the extension SHALL re-enable the editor and save the typed text again as a flush before navigating.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-072 — Block selection and block moves ignore input while a field editor is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-072.md) — While a field editor is open, the extension SHALL ignore the input that extends a block selection or moves a block.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-073 — The figure editor and the Start writing Enter shortcut ignore input while a field editor is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-073.md) — While a field editor is open, the extension SHALL ignore the Edit figure button and the document-wide Enter shortcut of the empty-document Start writing insert point.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-074 — A chosen enum value is posted when the select loses focus or Enter is pressed](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-074.md) — When a writer has chosen a value in the select of an enum field, the extension SHALL post the value when the select loses focus or Enter is pressed in it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-075 — Shift+Enter adds a line in a text field without saving](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-075.md) — When a writer presses Shift+Enter in the text box of a text field, the extension SHALL add a line without saving.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-076 — In a multi-line text value Enter adds a line and Cmd or Ctrl+Enter saves](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-076.md) — When the value of a text field holds a line break, the extension SHALL add a line on Enter and save it on Cmd or Ctrl+Enter.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-077 — Backspace in an empty list item removes it](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-077.md) — When a writer presses Backspace in an empty list item input, the extension SHALL remove the item and focus the previous one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-078 — Cmd or Ctrl+Enter in a list item saves the list](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-078.md) — When a writer presses Cmd or Ctrl+Enter in a list item input, the extension SHALL save the list.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-079 — A null value is refused when a conditional rule forbids it](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-079.md) — When a schema conditional rule forbids null for the edited field, the extension SHALL refuse a null save with "Schema validation failed: {message}".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-080 — The figure editor and insert points ignore input while a field editor is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-080.md) — While a field editor is open, the extension SHALL ignore the Edit figure button and the Enter key on an insert point.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-081 — A chosen enum value is posted when the select loses focus or Enter is pressed](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-081.md) — When a writer has chosen a value in the select of an enum field, the extension SHALL post the value when the select loses focus or Enter is pressed in it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-082 — An accepted field save shows that the preview is refreshing](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-082.md) — When the host reports a frontmatter save as saved, the extension SHALL show "Saved. Refreshing preview…" in the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-083 — A save for a missing field or revision is refused as stale](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-083.md) — When a frontmatter save names a field absent from the current analysis or a document revision that no longer matches, the extension SHALL answer "The frontmatter field is stale or its value does not match the schema."
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-084 — The field action menu stays inside its row in a narrow preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-084.md) — When the field action menu is shown, the extension SHALL keep the menu and its tooltips inside the edited row without covering the value or other rows, wrapping inside the row at about 520 px.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-085 — Hiding or closing the page saves the open field editor as a flush](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-085.md) — When the page is hidden or closed while a field editor is open, the extension SHALL save the typed text as a flush.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-086 — A closed schema flags the properties section](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-086.md) — When the schema root forbids additional properties, the extension SHALL flag the properties section with data-okf-additional-properties="false".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-087 — A tall properties table scrolls to both ends at 460 px and returns to line 1 on source sync](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-087.md) — When the preview is 460 px wide in edit mode with a tall properties table, the extension SHALL keep the table scrollable to both ends and return the preview to line 1 on a source sync to line 1.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
